styles.name: Putty retail bib apron with cocoa contrast ties and neck strap, no tax tab — Galloping Gourmet
styles.desc: Retail bib apron · Adjustable neck strap with buckle · Contrast fabric ties · Contrast neck strap · Plain black towel loop · Centre front pocket with pen pocket stitch divide · NO TAX TAB
styles.lectra: APP0534 — variant CNM: retail apron, mitred pocket, bib facing, contrast fabric ties 100 cm x 7.5 cm x 2, contrast neck strap 77 cm x 10 cm x 1
fabrics: Cocoa 100% organic cotton 260gsm X149ECO-AM307 (Tiajo) — contrast for neck strap and waist ties — rating 0.17M
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S PUTTY 08561 — cost per metre
THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S COCOA 08975 — for the contrast ties and neck strap
Oliver Harvey 'Button' Woven Centrefold Label (32x80mm) — set 4 cm down from the right side seam as worn
OLIVER HARVEY WASH CARE LABEL — 100% organic cotton · 40° wash · no bleach · 2 dot iron · tumble dry low · P dry clean — under the woven label
Black PLAIN non-tangle tape cut at 15" (no OH logo)
ANTIQUE BRASS 40MM DUNGAREE CLIP FLAP — brass effect buckle DCF40FLAP
OLIVER HARVEY BRASS 4 HOLE BUTTON — brass effect, OH logo at the top, sewn in black thread
Set into a bag, NO tissue; product sticker bottom right-hand corner of the bag; seal the bag
mfg: Make waist ties: fold in half, enclose raw edges, bag out the end and edgestitch one side down
Make neck strap: bag out one end, fold in raw edges and edgestitch the long edge
Neck strap inserted into the bib / bib facing on the RHSAW. Set bib facing
0.6 cm stitch across the top of the bib
Stitch down bib facing lower edge to form 5.5 cm topstitching
0.6 cm double turn hem at the "underarm" curved hems
Towel loop positioned to the curve, left side as worn, set 7.5 cm in from the left side seam cut edge (5 cm in from the FINISHED side seam)
Towel loop: fold the tie in half, stitch into the curved hem, fold to the front of the apron and stitch down following the 6 mm stitching of the armhole
1.2 cm double hem at side seams and bottom hem
Double turn 1 + 2 cm hem on the top of the pocket and topstitch 1.9 cm; triangle stitch on the top corners of the pocket
Pocket position: 29.5 cm up from the FINISHED hem and central to the width of the apron; edgestitch in position
Set stitch pen pocket x 2 to the RIGHT side of the pocket as worn, 3 cm wide x 13 cm deep
Oliver Harvey button on the front of the bib LHSAW, with the OH logo at the top of the button, sewn in black thread
Button position: 2 cm in from the finished side seam LHSAW and 2.5 cm down from the top edge of the bib; make sure the neck strap lies in line with the side of the bib when the buckle is fastened
fin: Check, trim, press, fold and set into a bag. NO TISSUE. Product sticker to the bottom right-hand corner of the bag. Seal the bag
styles.tol: Tolerance ± 1 cm (± 0.5 cm across the bib) · centre pocket 31.5 cm wide x 21.5 cm deep
